Each send is a new process with the whole chat flattened into one stdin message, so no cacheable prefix ever repeats (the ~250-token system prompt is under the cache minimum).

There is no filter, but Home sorts rows by urgency (needs > stuck > ready > running). A correctly classified waiting session already leads: kestrel showed on top as 'stuck 1m' with Approve. Every failure this bug shows (waiting sessions 'running' or missing, 'No live sessions.') is the classification and parking defect of r1-S2-02, with the 'running' part in r1-S2-01. A filter on top would hide the same missing rows.

True that the panel has no model control or regenerate: the header reads 'vibepet/main · claude code' and the only reply button is copy. The model is set in Settings › Chat model. For a 5-15-session user the wrong answers come from chat's context (r1-S2-01..04), and a regenerate or another model would repeat them. A per-message model switch is a feature request, not a defect.
